title: Recovery Callouts as an Adjustment to the Value of a Listed Vehicle
content:
A vehicle offered as a Keyturn Vehicle Listing that has had to be recovered is adjusted downward, and what is counted is the completed Keyturn Roadside Assistance callouts standing on the vehicle in the rolling twenty-four months counted back from the handling date.

- A vehicle with two or more completed Keyturn Roadside Assistance callouts in that window is adjusted to 0.95 of the figure, ninety-five hundredths.
- A vehicle with exactly one completed callout in that window is adjusted to 0.98 of the figure, ninety-eight hundredths.
- A vehicle with no completed callout in that window is carried at the figure unchanged, a share of 1.

### Points of judgement

*Only completed callouts count.* A callout standing on the vehicle that was not completed is not one of the callouts this adjustment counts.

*Where the count divides.* At 2 completed callouts in the window the first clause governs; at exactly 1 the second; at none the third. A vehicle with 6 completed callouts in the window is still on the first clause, which turns on two or more rather than on how many.

*Worked on a hypothetical figure.* A figure of 30000.00 USD adjusted at 0.95 gives 28500.00 USD; the same figure adjusted at 0.98 gives 29400.00 USD.
